g.text: 1 · VAULT DOOR — plates bolted to the door
2 · LEFT RAIL — black column, biggest dial that still fits
3 · BOTTOM DECK — console strip, dial sides stay clear
4 · BOLT RING — modifiers as the door bolts, icon only
5 · LCD CONSOLE — readout panel, modifiers as a list
6 · MINIMAL — max dial, icon stack in the margin
